overview: A teleport menu on a key, told in pictures: home, spawn, your last death, your geode, places you save yourself, and a face for every player online.
Asking to visit somebody waits on their yes.

1.1.0: A teleport request arrives in the notice tray, with buttons to accept or deny.
It still comes through chat for a game that cannot draw the tray.
/tpme bring asks somebody to come to you.
Every trip puts you down near where you asked, not in a wall or in lava.
Several people arriving at once land beside each other.
The menu fits its window, and its lists scroll.
1.0.1: A version number of its own, so the file could go up again. Nothing in the mod itself changed.
1.0.0: Home is wherever you would respawn. Spawn is the world's.
Last death comes from Dead Heads, your geode from Amethyst Door.
Your own places are saved where you stand, with a picture and a name you can skip.
It keeps itself current while it is open, and a request to travel lapses after a minute.
